```{r det_muts_analysis}
#Need to perform the analysis first to be able to put values in the summary text.

#Detected Mutations - Predicted Resistance
resis_df <- read_tsv(resis_output)

# Keep the raw (per-allele) matches for the anti-join that builds the
# "unknown significance" table - the collapse below rewrites Mutation.
resis_df_raw <- resis_df

# FASTA (Sanger consensus) input: there is no depth/frequency information, but
# mixed (IUPAC) positions carry MIXED / MIXED_REF flags. Collapse alleles that
# fall in the same codon into a single mixed-notation call:
#   two non-reference alleles      -> M460V/I
#   one allele + reference in mix  -> A594V/A
# and expose a "Mixed population" column. The collapsed label then flows through
# all downstream Gene/Mutation grouping unchanged.
if (is_fasta && nrow(resis_df) > 0) {
  resis_df$`Mixed population` <- ifelse(
    toupper(resis_df$mixed_population) == "YES", "Yes", "No"
  )

  # Collapse simple substitutions (e.g. M460V) that share a codon into a single
  # mixed-notation call: two non-reference alleles -> M460V/I; one allele with
  # the reference still in the IUPAC set -> A594V/A. Indels and other notations
  # are left exactly as db_matching.py produced them.
  is_sub <- grepl("^[A-Za-z]\\d+[A-Za-z*]$", resis_df$Mutation)

  collapse_codon <- function(df) {
    df <- df |> arrange(suppressWarnings(as.integer(POS)))
    alts <- paste(unique(str_extract(df$Mutation, "[A-Za-z*]$")), collapse = "/")
    ref  <- str_extract(df$Mutation[1], "^[A-Za-z]")
    cod  <- str_extract(df$Mutation[1], "\\d+")
    base <- paste0(ref, cod, alts)
    if (any(toupper(df$mixed_with_reference) == "YES") && !grepl("/", alts, fixed = TRUE))
      base <- paste0(base, "/", ref)
    df$Mutation <- base
    df$`Mixed population` <- if (any(toupper(df$mixed_population) == "YES")) "Yes" else "No"
    df
  }

  subs <- resis_df[is_sub, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(subs) > 0) {
    subs <- subs |>
      mutate(.codon = paste0(Gene, "_", str_extract(Mutation, "\\d+"))) |>
      group_split(.codon) |>
      lapply(collapse_codon) |>
      bind_rows() |>
      select(-.codon)
  }
  resis_df <- bind_rows(subs, resis_df[!is_sub, , drop = FALSE])
} else if (nrow(resis_df) > 0) {
  resis_df$`Mixed population` <- "No"
}

```

```{r key_muts_analysis}
# Key Mutations Characterised in the Literature
#
# The phenotype database (final_pheno_meta_analysis_*.csv) is already in long
# format: one row per Gene_Mutation / Drug combination, with a pre-computed
# Overall_EC50_Ratio (carried through by db_matching.py as EC50_ratio, rounded
# to 2 dp) and a pre-assigned Level_of_resistance. So there is no per-study
# averaging to do here - we just tidy and, where a mutation matched several
# database entries, collapse to a single row per Gene/Mutation/Drug.
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){

  levels <- c("Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High")

  # Collapse an ordered set of resistance levels to a single value or a range.
  format_level <- function(x){

    x <- factor(na.omit(x), levels = levels, ordered = TRUE)

    if(length(x) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    lo <- min(x)
    hi <- max(x)

    if(lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  # Format one or more EC50 ratios (already rounded to 2 dp) as a value or range.
  format_ec50 <- function(x){

    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
    nums <- sort(nums[!is.na(nums)])

    if(length(nums) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    fmt <- function(v) format(round(v, 2), trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0)

    if(min(nums) == max(nums))
      fmt(min(nums))
    else
      sprintf("%s–%s", fmt(min(nums)), fmt(max(nums)))
  }

  # Turn one or more ", "-delimited bibtex-key strings into "[@key1]; [@key2]".
  format_refs <- function(x){

    keys <- unlist(strsplit(paste(stats::na.omit(x), collapse = ", "), ",\\s*"))
    keys <- unique(trimws(keys))
    keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & keys != "" & keys != "NA"]

    if(length(keys) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    paste0("[@", keys, "]", collapse = "; ")
  }

  # Prefer exact single-mutation database entries; only fall back to compound
  # (combination-mutation) entries for a Gene/Mutation/Drug with no exact match.
  resis_use <- resis_df |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    filter(if(any(match_type == "exact")) match_type == "exact" else TRUE) |>
    ungroup()

  summary_df <- resis_use |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    summarise(
      `EC50 ratio` = format_ec50(EC50_ratio),
      `Level of resistance` = format_level(Level_of_resistance),
      Reference = format_refs(References),
      `Mixed population` = dplyr::first(`Mixed population`),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}



```


```{r}
#Are there any mutations?
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){
  level_order <- c(
    "Unknown",
    "Susceptible",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High"
  )

  highest_level <- function(x) {

    if (is.na(x) || x == "")
      return("Unknown")

    # Split ranges like "Low–Medium"
    levs <- unlist(strsplit(x, "–"))

    levs <- factor(levs,
                  levels = level_order,
                  ordered = TRUE)

    as.character(max(levs))
  }

  summary_table <- summary_df

  summary_table$Drug <- factor(
    summary_table$Drug,
    levels = c(
      "Ganciclovir",
      "Foscarnet",
      "Cidofovir",
      "Maribavir",
      "Letermovir"
    )
  )

  summary_table <-
    summary_table |>
    mutate(Resistance = vapply(`Level of resistance`, highest_level, character(1))) |>
    select(Gene, Mutation, `Mixed population`, Drug, Resistance) |>
    distinct() |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Drug,
      values_from = Resistance,
      names_expand = TRUE,
      values_fill = "Unknown"
    )

  summary_table <- summary_table |>
    select(
      Gene,
      Mutation,
      any_of(if (is_fasta) "Mixed population" else character(0)),

      Foscarnet,
      Cidofovir,
      Maribavir,
```

```{r unknown_sig_analysis}
# Mutations of Unknown Significance
all_muts <- read_tsv(all_muts_file)
#This outputs only mutations found in the resistance genes if protocol is amplicon, or all genes if protocol is wgs.
if(protocol == "amplicon"){
  genes <- c("UL27", "UL51", "UL54", "UL56", "UL89", "UL97")
  all_muts <- anti_join(all_muts, resis_df_raw, join_by("ANN[*].GENE" == "Gene", "AA_change" == "Mutation")) |> filter(`ANN[*].GENE` %in% genes)
} else if(protocol == "wgs"){
  all_muts <- anti_join(all_muts, resis_df_raw, join_by("ANN[*].GENE" == "Gene", "AA_change" == "Mutation"))
}

all_muts$`EFF[*].EFFECT` <- gsub("&", " & ", all_muts$`EFF[*].EFFECT`)

# Round any numeric values in a ", "-delimited string to `digits` dp, leaving
# non-numeric tokens (e.g. ".") untouched.
round_csv_numbers <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(v) {
    parts <- trimws(strsplit(v, ",")[[1]])
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
    ok <- !is.na(num)
    parts[ok] <- as.character(round(num[ok], digits))
    paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

all_muts <- all_muts |> filter(`EFF[*].AA` != ".") |> rowwise() |> mutate(`Ref > Alt` = paste0(REF, " > ", ALT), Effect = `EFF[*].EFFECT`, Gene = `ANN[*].GENE`, Frequency = round_csv_numbers(gsub(",", ", ", gsub("lofreq:|freebayes:|ivar:", "", `AF[*]`))), Depth = round_csv_numbers(gsub(",", ", ", gsub("lofreq:|freebayes:|ivar:", "", `DP[*]`))), `Variant Callers` = gsub(",", ", ", detected_by)) |> select(POS, `Ref > Alt`, Gene, AA_change, Effect, Frequency, Depth, `Variant Callers`) |> arrange(POS)

# FASTA consensus input has no per-variant depth or frequency, and the single
# "sanger" pseudo-caller column adds nothing - drop those columns.
if (is_fasta) {
  all_muts <- all_muts |> ungroup() |> select(-Frequency, -Depth, -`Variant Callers`)
}
```

```{r amr_cov_analysis}
# AMR Gene Coverage - depth/coverage is only meaningful for read (FASTQ) input.
if (!is_fasta) {
muts <- read_tsv(bed_file, col_names = FALSE)
colnames(muts) <- c("Genome", "start", "end", "label")

plot_gene_coverage <- function(bam,
                               bed,
                               min_depth,
                               chrom,
                               start,
                               end,
                               gene_name = NULL,
                               cds_start = NULL,
                               cds_end = NULL,
                               cds_names = NULL) {

  # Create genomic range covering the whole gene
  gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chrom,
    ranges = IRanges(start = start, end = end)
  )

  # Extract coverage
  cov <- coverage(
    BamFile(bam),
    param = ScanBamParam(which = gr)
  )

  multi_cds <- !is.null(cds_start)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Create coverage data frame
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  if (!multi_cds) {

    # Single continuous CDS
    depth_df <- data.frame(
      position = start:end,
      depth = as.numeric(cov[[chrom]][start:end]),
      Type = gene_name,
      segment = gene_name
    )

  } else {

    # Multiple CDS regions (e.g. spliced UL89) - plotted as separate panels
    # so the (often long) intron is not drawn.
    if (is.null(cds_names)) {
      cds_names <- paste0(gene_name, " (", seq_along(cds_start), ")")
    }

    depth_df <- purrr::map_dfr(
      seq_along(cds_start),
      function(i) data.frame(
        position = cds_start[i]:cds_end[i],
        depth = as.numeric(cov[[chrom]][cds_start[i]:cds_end[i]]),
        Type = gene_name,
        segment = cds_names[i]
      )
    )
    # keep panels in the order the CDS segments were supplied
    depth_df$segment <- factor(depth_df$segment, levels = cds_names)
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Get known AMR mutation positions to mark on plot
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  bed <- bed |>
    filter(str_detect(label, gene_name)) |>
    distinct(start, end, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      depth = mean(
        as.numeric(
          cov[[chrom]][start:end]
        )
      ),
      coverage_status = ifelse(
        depth >= min_depth,
        "Sufficient",
        "Insufficient"
      )
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  # Assign each marker to its CDS panel (so it is drawn only there).
  bed$segment <- gene_name
  if (multi_cds) {
    for (i in seq_along(cds_start)) {
      in_seg <- bed$start >= cds_start[i] & bed$end <= cds_end[i]
      bed$segment[in_seg] <- cds_names[i]
    }
    bed$segment <- factor(bed$segment, levels = cds_names)
  }

  # A codon is only ~3 bp wide, which is invisible on a gene-length x-axis.
  # Give each marker a minimum on-screen width of ~1% of its panel's range,
  # centred on the codon.
  panel_span <- depth_df |>
    group_by(segment) |>
    summarise(span = max(position) - min(position), .groups = "drop")
  bed <- bed |>
    left_join(panel_span, by = "segment") |>
    mutate(
      marker_w = 0.01 * span,
      xmin = pmin(start, (start + end) / 2 - marker_w / 2),
      xmax = pmax(end,   (start + end) / 2 + marker_w / 2)
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot(
    depth_df,
    aes(x = position, y = depth)
  ) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#94e4ca",
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Genome Position",
      y = "Depth"
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = bed,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.3,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = 0,
        ymax = Inf,
        fill = coverage_status
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Sufficient = "#90EE90",
        Insufficient = "red"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        0,
        max(min_depth, max(depth_df$depth))
      )
    )

  # Single CDS: one panel, gene name on the strip (as before).
  # Multiple CDS: one panel per segment, widths proportional to CDS length,
  # so the intron is omitted.
  if (multi_cds) {
    p <- p + facet_grid(
      rows = vars(Type),
      cols = vars(segment),
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x"
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + facet_grid(vars(Type))
  }

  return(p)
}

    cds_start = c(min(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_b_pos, "-")))), min(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_a_pos, "-"))))),
    cds_end = c(max(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_b_pos, "-")))), max(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_a_pos, "-"))))),
    cds_names = c("UL89 (exon B)", "UL89 (exon A)")
)

ul97_plot <- plot_gene_coverage(
    bam = bam_file,
    bed = muts,
    min_depth = threshold,
    chrom = reference,
    start = as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[1]),
    end = as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[2]),
    gene_name = "UL97"
)


plot <- plot_grid(ul27_plot, ul51_plot, ul54_plot, ul56_plot, ul89_plot, ul97_plot, ncol = 1, align = "hv")



if(protocol == "wgs"){
  cov <- coverage(BamFile(bam_file))
  header <- scanBamHeader(bam_file)
  chrom_lengths <- header[[1]]$targets
  depth_df <- data.frame(
      position = 1:chrom_lengths,
      depth = as.numeric(cov[[reference]][1:chrom_lengths])
  )

  depth_df$log_depth <- log(depth_df$depth)

  depth_df <- depth_df |> rowwise() |> mutate(log_depth = ifelse(log_depth == -Inf, 0, log_depth))
  gene_df <- data.frame(
    gene = c("UL27", "UL51", "UL54", "UL56", "UL89_B", "UL97"),
    start = c(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul27_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul51_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul54_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul56_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_b_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[1])),
    end   = c(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul27_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul51_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul54_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul56_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_b_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[2]))
  )

  gene_df$midpoint <- (gene_df$start + gene_df$end) / 2


  wgs_plot <- ggplot(depth_df, aes(position, log_depth)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "log Depth") +
    geom_rect(
        data = gene_df,
        aes(
            xmin = start,
            xmax = end,
            ymin = -Inf,
            ymax = Inf
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = "lightblue",
        alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = gene_df, aes(x = midpoint, y = Inf, label = gene), inherit.aes = FALSE, segment.color = NA)
}
} # end if(!is_fasta)
```

```{r insuff_analysis}
# table for AMR Gene Coverage

# FASTA input: no BAM, so no codons "below threshold". Provide an empty
# `insufficient` so the summary text and coverage sections below are simply skipped.
insufficient <- tibble(start = integer(0), label = character(0))

if (!is_fasta) {
cov <- coverage(
    BamFile(bam_file)
  )
# Get known AMR mutation positions to mark on plot
muts <- muts |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    depth = mean(
      as.numeric(
        cov[[reference]][start:end]
      )
    ),
    coverage_status = ifelse(depth >= threshold, "Sufficient", "Insufficient")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

insufficient <- muts |> filter(coverage_status == "Insufficient")
}

if(nrow(insufficient) > 0){
  coverage_summary <- insufficient |>
  mutate(
    Gene = str_extract(label, "^[^_]+"),
    Codon = label |>
      str_remove("^[^_]+_") |>       # remove UL97_
      str_remove("^DEL") |>          # remove DEL
      str_remove("[A-Z*]$")      # remove final AA or stop codon
  ) |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(
    `Codons below threshold` = n(),
    `Affected codons` = paste(Codon, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
}
```

```{r regions_assessed}
# FASTA input: which gene regions were covered by a submitted consensus record,
# and how well each aligned to the reference.
assessed_tbl <- NULL
if (is_fasta && nzchar(assessed_file) && file.exists(assessed_file)) {
  assessed_raw <- read_tsv(assessed_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (nrow(assessed_raw) > 0) {
    assessed_tbl <- assessed_raw |>
      transmute(
        Gene = gene,
        `Region assessed` = paste0(assessed_start, "–", assessed_end),
        `Aligned bp` = aligned_bp,
        `Identity (%)` = pct_identity,
        `Reverse-complemented` = ifelse(tolower(reverse_complemented) %in% c("yes", "true"), "Yes", "No"),
        `Variants called` = n_variants
      ) |>
      arrange(Gene)
  }
}
```

# Summary

```{r summary_sent1}
sentence1 <- NULL
sentence2 <- NULL
sentence3 <- NULL
sentence4 <- NULL
sentence5 <- NULL

mutation_summary <- function(n, genes) {

  if(n == 0) {
    return("No resistance-associated mutations were detected across the assessed CMV resistance-associated genes.")
  }

  gene_text <- paste(genes, collapse = " and ")

  if(n == 1) {
    return(
      paste0(
        "One resistance-associated mutation was detected in the ",
        gene_text,
        " gene."
      )
    )
  }

  return(
    paste0(
      n,
      " resistance-associated mutations were detected across the ",
      gene_text,
      " genes."
    )
  )
}

if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  n_muts <- 0
} else {
  n_muts <- length(tbl$`_data`$Mutation)
}

if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  n_genes <- 0
} else {
  n_genes <- unique(tbl$`_data`$Gene)
}
sentence1 <- mutation_summary(n_muts, n_genes)
```

```{r summary_sent2to4}
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){

  long_df <- summary_table |> pivot_longer(cols = 3:7, names_to = "Drug", values_to = "Level")

  high_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "High")

  med_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "Medium")

  low_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "Low")

  if(nrow(high_level) > 0) {
    
    high_text <- paste0(
      high_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      high_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence2 <- paste0(
      "High-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      high_text,
      "."
    )
  }

  if(nrow(med_level) > 0) {
    
    med_text <- paste0(
      med_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      med_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence3 <- paste0(
      "Medium-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      med_text,
      "."
    )
  } 

  if(nrow(low_level) > 0) {
    
    low_text <- paste0(
      low_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      low_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence4 <- paste0(
      "Low-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      low_text,
      "."
    )
  }
}
```
